title: Love potion
content:
# Love potion

Type: Mead | Internal ID: MeadTrollPheromones | Source: The Bog Witch | Usage: Drinking | Buy: 110, Coins, for 5 | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Duration: 5m | Cooldown: 0s

# Introduction

Love potion is a consumable item sold by The Bog Witch at 110 Coins for five potions.

## Effect

Its consumption increases the spawn rate of Trolls (from 5% to 25%), increases the chance of starred Trolls and increases the maximum number of spawned Trolls (from 1 to 2). All Trolls are also automatically on alert.

• stat: Base | Quality 0: 90% | Quality 1: 9% | Quality 2: 1%

• stat: Potion | Quality 0: 0% | Quality 1: 87.5% | Quality 2: 12.5%

## Notes

• Trolls spawning within 2000 meters of the center of the world remain without star.
• Trolls spawning in event raids will have at least one star, even if within 2000 meters of the center of the world.

Categorias: Mead
